name: comp-13

frames.best_why: The field is filled with a full amount while both the euro sign and EUR add-on stay visible.

tagline: A money field keeping the euro sign inside its left edge and EUR on the right.
summary: A single-line amount field with a label above it, a euro sign fixed inside the left edge and the letters EUR inside the right edge. Typing an amount pushes the placeholder out of the way.
appearance: A small label sits above a rounded dark text field on a black stage. Inside the field a grey euro sign hugs the left edge, a muted 0.00 placeholder starts after it, and the letters EUR sit at the right edge; focus draws a pale outline.
behaviour: Clicking the field shows a focus ring and a caret right after the euro sign, and typing fills the space between the two add-ons. The clip enters 1,250.00 and the field settles with the value held between prefix and suffix.
demo_content: Field labelled Input with inline add-ons, placeholder 0.00, filled with 1,250.00.
search_phrases: form field with text inside both ends
inline add-on for a text box
euro amount entry on a dark form
use_when: Collecting a price or payment amount where the currency should stay visible as the user types.
avoid_when: The euro sign and EUR text are fixed, so changing currency or locale means editing the file.
customise: The euro sign, EUR suffix and placeholder are written in the file; the field styling and disabled opacity are classes you can change there.
weight_why: One styled input and two text spans; nothing runs in the background.

a11y.note: A real label is bound to the field, but the add-on text sits outside the input so its meaning is not tied to the amount.

polish_why: Neat aligned add-ons and a clear focus ring, but it is a conventional single field.
title: Currency Input Add-on
